description: Fetch full order data (location, time windows, assignment, loads, skills, contact) for up to 500 orders by orderNo or id. Each result has its own success flag; missing orders come back with ERR_ORD_NOT_FOUND rather than failing the call. Read-only despite using POST. OptimoRoute: POST /get_orders.
